en.title: Frameset or complete bike in China? Compare the cost of a rideable build
en.description: Use dated frame-package prices, the catalog’s explicit allowance and an itemized build worksheet without counting included parts twice.
en.intro: A frame price and a complete-bike price answer different questions. A useful budget starts with what is actually included, then adds what is still missing. The China Bikes catalog offers a quick estimate and a separate itemized builder; they should not be mistaken for the same kind of quote.

sections.heading: Use the estimate to shortlist, not to place an order
paragraphs: The catalog’s frame-build price is the recorded frame-package price plus the selected remaining-build allowance. The table below shows that assumption explicitly. It is a planning convention, not a claim that a shop will deliver every shown configuration for that sum.

The [itemized builder](/build/) serves a different purpose: choose an exact base and component slots, then inspect what is known and what is missing. A known subtotal is not a complete budget while required slots, prices or compatibility information are unresolved.

sections.heading: Write down the package before adding components
paragraphs: Begin with the seller’s exact option name. Does it include the fork, headset, through-axles, seatpost, cockpit, hanger and small hardware? Are brakes included with a shifting package? Mark included parts once; do not add the same component again in another slot.

Then list the remaining drivetrain, brakes and rotors, wheels, tires, tubes or tubeless supplies, contact points, pedals and assembly work as applicable. Confirm what the mechanic’s quote includes. The objective is not to assume every build needs the same shopping list, but to make each omission explicit.

sections.heading: A cheap part that does not fit is not a saving
paragraphs: Check the recorded frame interfaces against the chosen components: bottom bracket and crank spindle, brake mount and rotor setup, axle dimensions, freehub and cassette, hanger and derailleur, and any cockpit or seatpost restrictions. Unknowns remain questions, not automatic passes.

The builder flags only constraints represented in the dataset. It does not inspect physical parts, guarantee compatibility or replace the manufacturer’s installation instructions. Share the actual component list with the person who will assemble the bike before purchasing.

sections.heading: Compare the same outcome
paragraphs: Put the completed worksheet beside a specific complete-bike configuration. Keep the fit, tire requirement, drivetrain layout and wheel choice visible. A lighter or more expensive wheelset in the self-build means the two budgets no longer describe the same outcome.

Also separate one-time build cost from support. Ask who handles a frame problem, a drivetrain problem and an assembly problem, and how shipping or workshop labor is treated. Do not assume that buying all components separately produces one unified warranty.

sections.heading: Keep the original dates
paragraphs: Save the quotation date and conditions for each large purchase. The comparison below retains the dates from the underlying catalog instead of presenting every figure as a new observation. A later editorial update does not turn an older price into a current offer.

For a quick start, compare one of the linked framesets with the specific Twitter complete build, adjust the allowance, and move to the builder only when the shortlist is useful. The result should be an understandable budget with visible gaps—not an artificially precise total.

zh-Hans.title: 在中国买车架组还是整车？比较真正能骑走的装车成本
zh-Hans.description: 先核对车架套餐，再结合有日期的价格、明确预算和逐项配置，避免重复计算内含配件。
zh-Hans.intro: 车架价格与整车价格回答的是不同问题。有效预算应先明确包含什么，再补上缺少的部分。China Bikes 提供快速估算和独立的逐项装车工具，两者不是同一种报价。

sections.heading: 估算适合筛选，不适合直接下单
paragraphs: 目录中的车架装车价，是记录中的车架套餐价格加上所选的剩余装车预算。下表会明确展示这个假设。这是规划方法，不代表某家车店保证按该数字交付指定配置。
[逐项装车工具](/build/)用于选择具体基础车型与各部件，再检查已知和缺失信息。只要必需槽位、价格或兼容性仍未确定，“已知小计”就不是完整预算。

sections.heading: 添加配件前，先写清套餐内容
paragraphs: 从卖家的准确选项名称开始：是否包含前叉、碗组、桶轴、座管、把组、尾钩及小配件？变速套餐是否已包含刹车？内含部件只计算一次，不能又在其他槽位重复加价。
然后按实际需要列出剩余变速、刹车与碟片、轮组、轮胎、内胎或真空胎耗材、接触部件、脚踏及装配费用，并确认车店报价的范围。目的不是假设每辆车都需要同一份购物清单，而是把遗漏写出来。

sections.heading: 不兼容的便宜配件不是省钱
paragraphs: 逐项核对已记录接口与所选配件：中轴及曲柄轴心、刹车座与碟片、桶轴尺寸、塔基与飞轮、尾钩与后拨，以及把组、座管的限制。未知项是问题，不是自动通过。
配置器只能提示数据中已记录的约束，不会检查实物，也不保证兼容性或取代厂家的安装说明。购买前，把具体配件单交给实际负责装车的人确认。

sections.heading: 比较同样的使用结果
paragraphs: 把完整清单与一个具体整车配置并排比较，保留合身、轮胎、单双盘和轮组选择。自组方案用了更轻或更贵的轮组，两份预算就不再对应同样的结果。
还要把一次性装车成本与售后分开。问清车架、变速与装配问题分别由谁负责，运费和工时如何处理。分别购买所有部件，不代表最终会得到统一保修。

sections.heading: 保留价格原本的日期
paragraphs: 保存每笔主要报价的日期和条件。下表保留底层目录的观察日期，不把每个数字包装成新报价。文章更新日期更晚，也不会让旧价格自动变成当前售价。
可以先选一个下方车架组与具体的骓特整车比较，调整装车预算；形成有用的短名单后，再进入配置器。目标是得到有清晰缺口的可理解预算，而不是看似精确的总数。
